rationale: Kanu 2026-11-03, his own description of the project

purpose.before: A due-diligence research spike testing whether a retail-scale systematic edge exists on Kalshi prediction markets, combining literature synthesis with stdlib-only Python scripts that census live markets and study orderbook depth.
purpose.after: Analysis of the areas of AI an individual can invest in: where the profit goes, how to get exposure, and how the areas compare, kept current.

desired_outcome.before: A reproducible Kalshi instrumentation layer - DuckDB ingest, decision log, markout gate, and calibration reporting - that can evaluate the section-4.7 gate (>=50 logged decisions, positive fee-adjusted expectancy) from logged data instead of ad hoc scripts.
desired_outcome.after: A sourced, ranked, regularly refreshed analysis of AI investment areas that Kanu can read and act on himself.
